svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How participants are divided
svg.desc: Of 171 participants with usable video, 43 form the test set and 128 form the development set, which is cut into five folds. Each person stays on one side.
svg.text: The same 43 people as the lab pilot’s test set; their earlier results are already known. Used
once, after every choice is fixed.
Development set: 128 people in five folds
Train on four folds, check on the fifth, then rotate (cross-validation). Folds are balanced by
balance score, age group and elite-athlete status.
Up to 18 task videos of one person, always on the same side of
Rescaling endpoints (lowest and highest values), the average used when a
method fails, examples shown to the model. StaBLE’s published endpoints
used all 180 people, so they are recomputed.
